name: Connected 07 - AI and ML Compute Platform

sav_input.mission: The AI research team and an ML compute platform vendor must agree on a contract for GPU-backed training and inference…
sav_input.final_decision:
{
  "GPU generations are upgraded": "Annual refresh included: upgrade to newest available GPU gen at same price",
  "GPU-backed training and inference infrastructure": "Reserved/dedicated GPU capacity vs on-demand/spot-burst capacity",
  "Training data is subject to GDPR": "Vendor as processor with DPA + SCCs (if any subprocessing) vs controller/processor split clarified",
  "a 3-year commitment": "3-year committed spend with annual true-up vs fixed monthly minimums",
  "a contract": "Master Services Agreement + auditable SOW with line items (compute, storage, network, support)",
  "a hard constraint": "Non-negotiable clause with termination right if breached",
  "ageing hardware": "No older than N-1 gen clause for all reserved capacity",
  "data residency": "EU-only residency (hard) with named regions (e.g., Frankfurt/Paris)",
  "how the security team audits the environment": "Provide SOC 2 Type II report annually + bridge letters on request",
  "meeting research deadlines": "Burst allowances: extra GPUs at committed rates for X days/month",
  "over the contract term": "Guaranteed roadmap milestones (e.g., refresh at month 12/24)",
  "support responsiveness": "Standard support (business hours) with 4-hour P1 response",
  "the deployment model": "Fully managed SaaS (vendor operated)",
  "training-job failures": "Incident classification: P1 for job-stopping failures vs P2 for degraded performance"
